tags.gist: Wants clear clinically meaningful metrics, acceptance thresholds, critical-error criteria and subgroup performance requirements defined.
Suggests expanding the two axes to autonomy, detectability, reversibility, human oversight, patient vulnerability and severity of harm.
Wants retraining requirements covering documentation of data changes, version control, bias assessment and before-and-after performance comparison.
Wants proactive monitoring of drift, clinically significant errors, near misses, clinician overrides, subgroup performance and real-world data changes.
Wants risk-based reassessment triggers after updates, retraining or third-party model changes, with re-benchmarking against the premarket baseline.
Recommends a continuous, risk-adaptive lifecycle framework linking premarket evaluation, deployment, monitoring, modification and revalidation.
